source_reason: 原题要求创建 Excel 后再创建 Training Interest Survey；编排在读取数据时就创建表单，此时工作簿尚未生成，违反明确的交付顺序。
interpretation: 删除在读取分支中并行创建 Form 的安排，改为 policy → SQL → Excel 完成及回读 → Form 创建及核验 → 邮件的单主 agent 顺序；保持原版无需委派、一次聚合和其他计算口径。

changes.original: Read `Training_Policy.pdf` and run one set-based SQL query that returns every department–education row plus the department totals needed for the second sheet.
changes.replacement: Read `Training_Policy.pdf` first for policy context; its budget figures are background only and need not appear in the analysis file. Then run one set-based SQL query over `HR_ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.EMPLOYEES`
changes.explanation: 显式展开原题先 policy 后查询的顺序，保留一条 set-based 查询返回两 sheet 所需数据。

changes.original: In parallel with that read branch, create `Training Interest Survey` exactly once and add the four questions in the stated order;
changes.replacement: Only after the Excel file has been created successfully and its read-back verified, create `Training Interest Survey` exactly once.
changes.explanation: 核心修正：以 Excel 实际完成为 Form 创建的前置条件，不能仅准备过数据就建 Form。

changes.original: Verify the workbook and Form once, then send one email to `training@company.com`
changes.replacement: Finally, after both artifacts have been verified, send one email to `training@company.com`
changes.explanation: 将原有一次核验按依赖分别放在 Excel 和 Form 后，最终邮件仍等待两者。

preserved_requirements: 主 agent 完成、没有子 agent；Training_Policy.pdf 先读，预算仅背景。
HR_ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.EMPLOYEES 的三个指定列；每个 department-education 组合；按部门和教育字母排序。
HR_Education_Analysis.xlsx 两指定 sheet、4/7 列精确表头、平均绩效两位、高学历占比一位；Diploma 只进总人数。
表单准确名称、四题顺序、两组各四个精确选项；创建恰一次。
工作簿与 Form 各核验一次、最后指定收件人邮件、包含 education analysis findings 的原有约束。
plan_summary: 主 agent 读政策并执行一次聚合，创建及回读 Excel。
Excel 成功后主 agent 创建和核验 Form；失败时阻断后续创建。
两产物成功后发送教育分析邮件。
expected_tradeoff: 增加 Excel 到 Form 的等待会减少并行重叠，但候选按原题顺序约束执行；实际成功率和耗时仍待实验。
